HISTORY.Take A Virtual TourDISCOVER THE PAST WITH USHISTORYPublications & Articles We've made several of our books about New Castle history available for free!MORE >>ARTIFACTSCollections & Archives Check out some of the highlights of the New Castle Historical Society's collections!MORE >>EXHIBITIONSVisit a Virtual Exhibit We've adapted some of our history exhibits so you can enjoy them online!MORE >>EXPLORE OUR MUSEUMSThe New Castle Historical Society operates two historic house museums to share the history of our community - the c. 1690 Dutch House and the 1738 Amstel House. Both are open to the public for tours, programs and exhibitions throughout the year.​​ ​ ​ ​Plan Your VisitTHE DUTCH HOUSELearn about life in this 17th century Dutch colony in one of New Castle's oldest remaining houses. Furnished with Dutch colonial antiques, the Dutch House offers a unique experience for visitors. ​READ MORE >>THE AMSTEL HOUSEDiscover New Castle's rebellious side in the Amstel House, the home of Governor Nicholas Van Dyke during the Revolutionary War. With family and period artifacts throughout, you'll make a personal connection with America's past.READ MORE >>ENJOY OUR PROGRAMS & EVENTSWith a variety of educational programs and special events offered throughout the year, you'll find plenty of opportunities with us to indulge your inner historian!FOURTH FRIDAY ART ON THE TOWNJoin us as we celebrate the arts at in Historic New Castle on the Fourth Friday of each month. (except December) New Castle's downtown businesses, restaurants and historic sites host receptions and exhibitions. ​ This Month's ScheduleWINTER & SPRING LECTURESWe have great lectures coming up as we kick of the celebration of the Seimquincentennial of Delaware and the United States Check our events page formore info and registration details!AMERICA AT 250In 2026, we will celebrate the 250th anniversary of Delaware and the United States - and the 375th anniversary of European settlement in New Castle.
